Official overview
Experience refined living at Oakwood Premier Cozmo Jakarta, perfectly situated in the exclusive Mega Kuningan central business district. This prestigious location places you at the heart of Jakarta’s corporate landscape, offering convenient access to multinational corporations and embassies. Beyond business, you are just moments away from high-end shopping destinations and vibrant entertainment facilities. Our central positioning ensures a dynamic and fulfilling stay while providing a comfortable sanctuary amid the city's energy.

Our property features 195 lavishly furnished apartments, ranging from spacious studios to expansive three-bedroom residences. Each apartment is thoughtfully designed to provide a comfortable and luxurious home environment. You will find a fully-equipped kitchen, complete with an oven, refrigerator, microwave, and cooking stove, with a coffee machine or Nespresso machine in selected units. A separate living area, dining space, flat-screen television, and, for your convenience, a washing machine are also provided. Private bathrooms offer hot or cold shower facilities, with some units also featuring a bathtub.

Oakwood Premier Cozmo Jakarta offers an extensive array of facilities and services designed to cater to your every need. Maintain your fitness routine at our 24-hour fitness centre, which provides inspiring views of the Jakarta skyline. Take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool, complete with a dedicated children's pool, or relax in the jacuzzi and sauna. For dining, our signature establishment, the Oakroom Restaurant & Bar, serves an excellent selection of international gourmet classics, alongside popular Indonesian and Asian favourites for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Families will appreciate the dedicated children's playroom.

Beyond these amenities, guests benefit from 24-hour reception and security with CCTV surveillance, ensuring peace of mind. Complimentary WiFi is available throughout the property, and daily housekeeping services and room service are provided. For your professional needs, we offer impressive meeting facilities and a comprehensive business centre. Additional conveniences include laundry and dry cleaning services, a convenience store, and a dedicated concierge team ready to assist you, including arranging a doctor-on-call service.

Official summary
Strategically located in the exclusive neighborhood within the central business district of Mega Kuningan, Oakwood Premier Cozmo Jakarta sits in the heart of luxury and prestige and boasts easy access to multinational corporations, embassies and high-end shopping and entertainment facilities.
Designed for the sophisticated traveler - both business and leisure alike, Oakwood Premier Cozmo Jakarta offers 195 lavishly furnished studio to three-bedroom units, exceptional recreational facilities and impressive meeting spaces - all primed to deliver distinctive experiences.

Official location
Oakwood Premier Cozmo Jakarta enjoys a prime position within the exclusive Mega Kuningan neighbourhood, placing you directly in the heart of Jakarta's Central Business District. This prestigious area is renowned for its concentration of multinational corporations, diplomatic embassies, and a sophisticated array of high-end shopping and entertainment.

Connectivity is excellent: the Bendungan Hilir MRT Station is within a 14 to 23-minute walk, and the TransJakarta Karet Sudirman bus station is conveniently located nearby, ensuring easy access across the city. Arrival is straightforward, with Halim Perdanakusuma International Airport (HLP) approximately a 20-minute drive away, and Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK) reachable in about 45 minutes by car or via the airport train connection.

Official apartment cards (published live types)
Studio Premier (40 sqm / 431 sqft, Max 2 pax, 1 King-size bed). Spotting a modern design with natural light, our Studio Premier is perfect for business executives or independent travellers. Fitted with a king-sized bed, each unit also comes with an ensuite bathroom equipped with a choice of drench or rain shower. Each Studio Premier apartment features a fully-equipped kitchen with modern conveniences such as microwave, refrigerator, Nespresso coffee machine, washer and dryer, multi-channel cable TV and in-room safe.

Studio Sky Suite (55 sqm / 592 sqft, Max 2 pax, 1 King-size bed). Enjoy views of the city from high above in this bright, modern style Studio Sky Suite, ideal for those seeking privacy and luxury. Take a warm refreshing shower in the en-suite bathroom or indulge in a deep soak in our marble bathtub. Each suite features a fully-equipped kitchen with modern conveniences such as microwave, refrigerator, Nespresso coffee machine, washer and dryer, multi-channel cable TV and in-room safe.

1 Bedroom Premier (65 sqm / 700 sqft, Max 2 pax, 1 King-size bed). Retreat to our modern-luxury one-bedroom premier apartment, designed for business executives or couples seeking a spacious living space with comfort and style. Enjoy an intimate dining area furnished with a stylish counter-height dining table and luxuriate in the relaxing surrounds of the living room. The apartment equipped with multi-channel cable TV, fully-equipped kitchen with microwave, refrigerator, Nespresso coffee machine, washer and dryer and in-room safe.

1 Bedroom Sky Suite (70 sqm / 753 sqft, Max 2 pax, 1 King-size bed). Our spacious One-bedroom Sky Suite boasts stunning skyline views, a perfect choice for business executives looking for luxury, comfort and convenience of home which features separate living and dining areas. Rejuvenate with a refreshing shower in a modern ensuite bathroom. The apartment also comes with a fully-equipped kitchen, microwave, refrigerator, Nespresso coffee machine, washer and dryer, drench/rain shower, bathtub, multi-channel cable TV and in-room safe.

1 Bedroom Deluxe Apartment (70 sqm / 753 sqft, Max 2 pax, 1 King-size bed). Perfect for the busy executive or independent traveler, our one-bedroom deluxe apartment combines luxury and convenience for an unforgettable, refined serviced living experience. Enjoy an elegantly appointed living room, intimate dining space for two and spacious bedroom fit with a king-size bed and en-suite bathroom. Each accommodation comes with complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully equipped open kitchen fit with a microwave and oven; multi-channel cable TV; drench/rain shower; home entertainment system with DVD; washer and dryer; and an in-room safe.

1 Bedroom Executive King Apartment (100 sqm / 1076 sqft, Max 2 pax, 1 King-size bed; Sofa bed). Retreat to the stunning one-bedroom executive apartment - and luxuriate in the master bedroom and en-suite bathroom equipped with a rain shower. Designed to accommodate executives seeking to balance work, play and rest, the apartment features distinct, dedicated spaces: such as the separate study room and a sofa bed for an additional guest. Each accommodation comes with complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped western style kitchen with a microwave; multi-channel cable TV; drench/rain shower; comprehensive home entertainment system; washer and dryer; and an in-room safe.

1 Bedroom Executive Twin Apartment (100 sqm / 1076 sqft, printed card / API Max 2 pax; official FAQ 3 Persons, Twin beds plus Sofa bed). Our one-bedroom executive twin apartment delivers comfort and convenience and accommodates up to 3 persons with two luxurious twin-size beds in the master bedroom and a separate sofa bed in the study room. Catch up on some work and casual reading, host virtual meetings in the dedicated study room or relax and dine in the separate lounge and dining spaces. Each accommodation comes with complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped western style kitchen with a microwave; multi-channel cable TV; drench/rain shower; comprehensive home entertainment system; washer and dryer; and an in-room safe.

2 Bedroom Superior Apartment (100 sqm / 1076 sqft, Max 3 pax, 1 King-size bed and 1 single bed). Space, comfort and privacy are delivered in our two-bedroom superior apartments; catered for families of three. Thoughtfully designed and luxuriously appointed, the apartment unit features a king-size bed or two twin beds in the master bedroom, and one single bed in the second bedroom as well as a spacious lounge, kitchen and dining areas. Each accommodation comes with complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped western style kitchen with a microwave; multi-channel cable TV; drench/rain shower; comprehensive home entertainment system; washer and dryer; and an in-room safe.

2 Bedroom Deluxe Apartment (133 sqm / 1432 sqft, Max 4 pax, 1 King-size bed and 1 queen-size bed). Tailored for families, discover unmatched comfort in style in our two-bedroom deluxe apartment where premium amenities and classic interiors highlight the elegance and functionality of each space. Immerse yourself in a sound sleep in the plush beddings, from a king-size bed in the master bedroom, a queen-size bed in the second bedroom and a spacious dining area for six. The apartment also accommodates for a helper's room, which can be converted into a storage area. Each accommodation comes with complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped closed kitchen with a microwave and oven; multi-channel cable TV; bathtub; drench/rain shower; comprehensive home entertainment system with DVD; washer and dryer; and an in-room safe.

2 Bedroom Premier (140 sqm / 1507 sqft, Max 4 pax, 1 King-size bed and 1 queen-size bed). Experience our lavish and spacious Two-bedroom Premier Sky Suite with elevated sky views, designed for business executives or independent travellers with families seeking for long stays. This sophisticated apartment consists of a spacious living room, separate dining area and a fully-equipped kitchen with a wide array of kitchenware and appliances. The apartment also comes with multi-channel cable TV, microwave, Nespresso coffee machine, bathtub, drench/rain shower, washer and dryer and an in-room safe.

2 Bedroom Executive Apartment (145 sqm / 1561 sqft, Max 4 pax, 1 King-size bed and 1 queen-size bed). Lavishly appointed, the two-bedroom executive apartment provides a home-away-from-home sanctuary of luxury that caters to families seeking long stays. Refresh your senses with the rain shower or luxuriate in a soak at day's end in the marble bathtub. Unwind in optimal comfort with the plush beddings, such as a king-size bed in the master bedroom, queen-size bed in the second bedroom and spacious living room and dining area. The apartment also comes with a helper's room, which can be used as a storage area. Each apartment comes with complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped open kitchen with a microwave and oven; multi-channel cable TV; bathtub; drench/rain shower; home entertainment system with DVD; washer and dryer; and an in-room safe.

3 Bedroom Deluxe Apartment (160 sqm / 1722 sqft, Max 6 pax, 1 King-size bed and 2 queen-size beds). Experience unparalleled luxury with our three-bedroom deluxe apartments, tailored for families seeking an oasis of comfort, exclusivity and sophisticated style. Beautifully appointed with classic, elegant interiors, each residence is fitted with a master bedroom with king-size bed, a queen-size bed in the second and third bedrooms, a generously sized living room and dining area. Roomy wardrobes and a helper's room, which doubles up as a storage area further accentuates the spaciousness of the living space. Each apartment comes with complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped open kitchen with a microwave and oven; multi-channel cable TV; bathtub; drench/rain shower; home entertainment system with DVD; washer and dryer; and an in-room safe.

Official overview
Oakwood Suites Kuningan Jakarta welcomes you to a refined stay within the vibrant Central Business District of Jakarta.
